title: The Cloud Is Actually Giant Buildings Full of Computers

segments.text: The cloud is not in the sky, it is warehouses of computers.
When you save a photo online, it goes to a data center.
These buildings hold thousands of drives.
They run day and night, all over the world.
Huge cooling systems stop them overheating.
So the cloud is really someone else's computer.
